_comment: Tuning for giveaway_finder.py. Keys starting with _ are ignored; missing keys fall back to the built-in defaults. README.md explains each key.
_cost: Sized for Apify's free $5 a month: 3 searches x 8 posts = 24 posts a day at $0.005 each, about $0.12 per run or $3.75 a month. See README > Cost.
_hashtags: Hashtag pages show popular posts (big giveaways, poor odds) and cost the same per post, so they are off to save credit. Example: ["gewinnspiel", "verlosung"].
_results_per_seed: Posts per hashtag or search query - the main cost driver. 9 still fits the free plan (~$4.20 a month) but leaves little room for manual runs.
_apify_input_extra: Merged into the actor input last. {"videoSearchSorting": "LATEST"} and videoSearchDateFilter returned no posts in October 2026; try them again later.
_max_cost_per_run_usd: Hard cap per run. $0.50 is the lowest value the actor accepts.
_monthly_budget_usd: Skip a run if it could push this Apify billing cycle past this amount. null = your plan's limit ($5 on the Free plan).
_percentile_cutoff: Keep the cheapest X% of giveaways (by competitors per prize, against the last 30 days).
_always_show_keywords: Giveaways mentioning one of these are listed (marked 💎) even when their odds are above the cutoff. Whole words, any case; short endings match too (iPhones, Reisen).
